description: A director of developer experience must finalize the retirement plan for a public API version, deciding whether to use a compatibility layer and what customer migration support to provide, with input from the SDK maintainer and customer success lead.

shared_context.S1: The company is retiring public API v1 and has published migration documentation for API v2.
shared_context.S2: The current draft plan disables v1 on July 1, relies on customers to migrate directly to v2, and provides the standard migration FAQ.
shared_context.S3: Riley makes the binding decision on the deprecation plan.
shared_context.S4: As part of the normal deprecation review, Riley asks the SDK and customer-success owners to report their readiness findings before the plan is finalized. Once both owners have reported, Riley may finalize the plan immediately; unresolved follow-up questions do not delay that decision.

PF1.text: While investigating an unrelated mobile SDK issue this morning, Devon found that SDK version 4.8 is still used by exactly 6,400 active installations and sends v1 requests; the gateway can translate those requests to v2 only when compatibility traffic is capped at exactly 120 requests per minute per tenant. Devon has not updated the deprecation ticket yet because the SDK investigation is still open.

PF2.text: During a separate renewal review yesterday, Marisol confirmed that exactly 3 enterprise accounts have integrations that cannot be changed by their application teams without guided migration sessions; each account needs weekly migration office hours during the transition. She has not added this support requirement to the deprecation ticket yet because the renewal review is still being reconciled.

acceptance_conditions: The deprecation must use a compatibility-proxy mode rather than direct hard disablement.
The compatibility proxy must be enabled.
Proxy traffic must be capped at exactly 120 requests per minute per tenant.
Exactly 3 enterprise accounts must receive guided migration support.
Weekly migration office hours must be included.
A commitment indicating migration support, guided migration, or migration office hours must be recorded.

content_checks.C1: 'phased' in decisions['deprecation_mode'] or 'proxy' in decisions['deprecation_mode'] or 'translation' in decisions['deprecation_mode']
content_checks.C6: any('migration' in c['type'] or 'support' in c['type'] or 'guided migration' in c['detail'] or 'office hours' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The public draft supports direct disablement; PF1 changes the mode to a compatibility proxy or translation approach, enables it, and sets its tenant limit to exactly 120 requests per minute.
The standard FAQ offers no targeted assistance; PF2 changes the plan to guided support for exactly 3 accounts, weekly office hours, and a migration-support commitment.
